assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.badge: every turn is a run of its own

intro.title: Ask about a run, or change something
intro.body: The assistant acts through the same governed actions these screens use. It holds no authority and no credentials, and each of its turns is recorded and metered as a run.

composer.label: Message the assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask about a run, or change something
composer.pending: Sending a turn arrives with the engine connection (stella serve, ADR-053). Until then the assistant only reports its health here.

down.title: The Stella engine is not answering
down.body: stella serve returned {status} from the engine container. The engine is a required service; nothing falls back to an in-process loop, so the assistant says so by name rather than degrading quietly.
down.unwired: The engine health read failed with {code} (HTTP {status}). The engine is a required service; nothing falls back to an in-process loop, so the assistant says so by name rather than degrading quietly.
down.metaUnknown: engine version not reported · last healthy time not recorded
down.composerPlaceholder: Unavailable while the engine is down

account.title: Account
account.footer: Profile and preference changes run as set_preferences, a governed action audited like any other, once that write is wired. Today only the theme changes here, and it is stored on this device.

unavailable.title: Your account could not load
unavailable.body: Error {code} (HTTP {status}). Theme still works, because it is stored on this device.

profile.rolesHint: A role is changed on the Organization page by someone who holds set_member_role, never here. This is where you see what you hold.

preferences.localeHint: Dates, numbers and currencies format to this. Prose the models generate is generated in this locale and recorded on the frame. Machine-readable fields in records, receipts and exports are never translated.
preferences.currencyHint: Display only. The value of record stays the provider's billing currency, and every converted number carries its rate and source.

security.totpEnrolled: TOTP, added {date}. {remaining, plural, one {# recovery code unused} other {# recovery codes unused}}.
security.passkeyHint: A passkey replaces the password, not the second factor.
security.sessionsHint: Revoking a session ends it at the next request. It does not touch an agent credential or a run token; those are revoked on the Agents page, and that is what makes a halt stick.

privacy.exportHint: A signed bundle: archive segments, attestations, key ids and a verifier script, so an auditor can check the chain offline without trusting Oxagen. It runs as export_data, a governed action with third-party egress.
privacy.erasureHint: Erasure is crypto-shredding: bodies attributable to a person are encrypted under a per-subject key, and erasure destroys the key and writes a tombstone frame holding the digests that remain. The chain stays intact and verifiable; the content is unrecoverable. It cannot be undone, and it needs an org owner.
